name: Holmy Lafore
source:
Laforet Hills is the name of a secluded farm somewhere in the Midwest. It once belonged to an influential family of French colonists, from which it got its name, but now it is home to the Holy Father, preaching in a nearby town, all alone.
Time in Laforet Hills slowly stretches day by day and year by year. Sometimes it seems as if life itself has taken some time out in order to lie down under the crown of a tree and take a break from the endless hustle and bustle.

It continues like this until the younger sister of the only inhabitant of the farm suddenly appears. She left her father's house many years ago, without saying a word to anyone, and since then there has been no news about her. The Holy Father, of course, is incredibly happy in receiving such an unexpected visit, until he finds out the true reason for her return.

[Translated from [url=https://galanos.itch.io/laforet-hills]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拉弗雷山 (Laforet Hills) 是中西部某处僻静农场的名称。它曾经属于一个有影响力的法国殖民者家族，并由此得名，但现在它是教宗的家，独自在附近的一个城镇传教。
拉弗雷山的时间一天天、一年年慢慢地拉长。有时，生命本身似乎已经抽出了一些时间，以便躺在树冠下，从无尽的喧嚣中休息一下。

就这样一直持续下去，直到农场唯一居民的妹妹突然出现。她多年前就离开了父亲的家，没有对任何人说过一句话，从那以后就再也没有她的消息了。教宗当然对收到如此意外的来访感到非常高兴，直到他找出她回来的真正原因。
